layoutSteps: Place the Astrid Bouclé Sofa facing the entertainment wall.
Center the Nordic Wool Rug beneath the seating area.
Install the Solace Pendant Lamp above the coffee table.
Position the Travertine Wall Mirror opposite the window.
Decorate corners using the Concrete Planter Set.

Hang travertine stone pendant light fixtures above key reading corners.
